## DETAILED BUDGET BREAKDOWN

### 13-Week Financial Model

```
TOTAL BUDGET: $500,000 (13 weeks / 3 months)
AVERAGE WEEKLY BURN: ~$38.5K/week

PHASE 1 (WEEKS 1-4): LEGAL + MVP DEVELOPMENT
├─ Target burn: $15K/week × 4 weeks = $60K
├─ Allocation:
│  ├─ Salaries: $8K/week (1 founder, contractor hiring started)
│  ├─ Legal: $3K/week (incorporation, attorney retainer, contracts)
│  ├─ Product/Infrastructure: $2K/week (AWS, domain, tools)
│  ├─ Sales/Marketing: $1K/week (tools, prep)
│  └─ Admin: $1K/week (insurance, accounting, misc)
└─ Total Phase 1: $60K remaining

PHASE 2 (WEEKS 5-8): FULL TEAM + SALES EXECUTION
├─ Target burn: $20K/week × 4 weeks = $80K
├─ Allocation:
│  ├─ Salaries: $12K/week (2 engineers + sales hired, all part-time)
│  ├─ Product/Infrastructure: $3K/week (compute, databases, tools)
│  ├─ Sales/Marketing: $3K/week (travel, sales tools, customer gifts)
│  ├─ Legal/Compliance: $1K/week (contracts, compliance)
│  └─ Admin: $1K/week (insurance, accounting, office)
└─ Total Phase 2: $140K allocated, $325K remaining

PHASE 3 (WEEKS 9-13): POST-REVENUE + GROWTH
├─ Target burn: $25K/week × 5 weeks = $125K
├─ Allocation:
│  ├─ Salaries: $14K/week (full team + CSM hired, scaling)
│  ├─ Product/Infrastructure: $5K/week (scaling compute, monitoring)
│  ├─ Sales/Marketing: $3K/week (case studies, content, travel)
│  ├─ Customer Success: $2K/week (implementation, support)
│  └─ Admin/Legal: $1K/week (overhead)
└─ Total Phase 3: $125K allocated, $200K remaining

CONTINGENCY BUFFER: $200K
├─ Purpose: Extend runway if first revenue delayed
├─ Trigger: Used if revenue > 8 weeks delayed
├─ Extension: 8-10 weeks additional runway
└─ Series A bridge: Cover burn until Series A closes
```

## REVENUE RECOGNITION POLICY

### When Revenue is Recognized

**Policy:** Revenue recognized on customer go-live (not contract signature)

```
REVENUE TIMING EXAMPLES

Customer #1: $50K ACV ($4,167/month)
├─ Contract Signed: Week 7 (Mar 10)
├─ Implementation: Weeks 7-10 (14-21 days)
├─ Go-Live: Week 10 (Mar 31) ← REVENUE RECOGNIZED HERE
├─ Monthly Revenue: $4,167/month (starting Apr 1)
├─ Quarterly Revenue: $12,500 (for Q2: Apr 1-30)
└─ ARR Recognition: Full $50K (recognized from go-live date)

Customer #2: $40K ACV ($3,333/month)
├─ Contract Signed: Week 8 (Mar 24)
├─ Go-Live: Week 11 (Apr 7) ← REVENUE RECOGNIZED HERE
├─ Monthly Revenue: $3,333/month (starting Apr 7)
├─ Quarterly Revenue: $10,000 (for Q2: Apr 7-30)
└─ ARR: Full $40K

Customer #3: $35K ACV ($2,917/month)
├─ Contract Signed: Week 9 (Mar 26)
├─ Go-Live: Week 11 (Apr 7) ← REVENUE RECOGNIZED HERE
├─ Monthly Revenue: $2,917/month (starting Apr 7)
├─ Quarterly Revenue: $8,750 (for Q2: Apr 7-30)
└─ ARR: Full $35K

TOTAL QUARTERLY REVENUE (Q2: Apr-Jun)
├─ April: ~$10.4K (full month, Customer #1 + partial #2, #3)
├─ May: ~$10.4K (all 3 customers full month)
├─ June: ~$10.4K (all 3 customers full month)
└─ Total Q2: ~$31.2K ($125K ARR run-rate by end of Q2)
```

## CASH FLOW SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS

### Best Case Scenario (Revenue Accelerated)

```
IF FIRST REVENUE COMES WEEK 5 (instead of Week 7):
├─ Customer #1 contract: Week 5 (Feb 28)
├─ Go-live: Week 8 (Mar 17)
├─ Revenue impact: +$10K (one month earlier)
├─ Cash position improvement: +$10K
└─ New runway: 23+ weeks (vs 21+ weeks)
└─ Status: No change to Series A timeline
```

### Worst Case Scenario (Revenue Delayed)

```
IF FIRST REVENUE DELAYED TO WEEK 10 (2-week slip):
├─ Customer #1 contract: Week 10 (Mar 24)
├─ Go-live: Week 13 (Apr 14)
├─ Revenue impact: -$20K (delayed by 1 month)
├─ Cash position impact: -$20K burn extension
└─ New runway: 19+ weeks (vs 21+ weeks)
└─ Status: Still safe, Series A conversations start
```

### Critical Scenario (Revenue Delayed 8+ Weeks)

```
IF REVENUE DELAYED TO WEEK 12 (5+ week slip):
├─ Total additional burn: ~$50K-100K (5+ weeks × $20K)
├─ New cash position: $230-280K (vs $332K baseline)
├─ New runway: 12-16 weeks (RED FLAG)
├─ Mitigation:
│  ├─ Reduce team to 3 FTE (-$30K/week in salaries)
│  ├─ Focus 100% on sales (no new product features)
│  ├─ Pause non-essential spending (-$10K/week)
│  └─ Series A discussions accelerate to Day 50 (not Day 84)
└─ Status: URGENT - Board meeting + fundraising plan
```

## SPENDING GUARDRAILS (Cost Controls)

### Weekly Spend Limits (by category)

| Category | Weekly Limit | Notes | Approval |
|----------|--------------|-------|----------|
| **Salaries** | $14K | Grow to $18K by Week 9 | CEO |
| **Legal** | $3K | Higher in W1-2, drops after | CEO |
| **Infrastructure** | $2-5K | Scales with customer growth | CTO |
| **Sales/Travel** | $1-2K | Increases Week 4+ | VP Sales |
| **Marketing/Content** | $1K | Starts Week 8+ | VP Sales |
| **Admin/Overhead** | $1K | Fixed overhead | CEO |
| **TOTAL WEEKLY LIMIT** | **$22K** | Escalates to $25K by Week 9 | CFO |

### Expense Approval Workflow

```
EXPENSE APPROVAL MATRIX

< $500: Manager approval (same-day)
$500-$2,000: Manager + CEO approval (1 day)
$2,000-$10,000: CEO approval (next day)
> $10,000: Board approval (1 week)

EXAMPLES:
├─ Software tool ($200): Manager approves
├─ Engineer contractor ($3K/week): CEO approves
├─ Legal expense ($8K): CEO approves
├─ Acquisition spend ($50K): Board approves
└─ Fundraising advisor ($15K): Board approves
```

### Red Flags (Trigger Financial Review)

🔴 **Critical:** If ANY of these occur, emergency financial review

1. **Weekly spend > $25K** (2x plan)
2. **Monthly burn > 3% of cash** ($15K+)
3. **Unplanned major expense** (> $20K)
4. **Revenue delay beyond 2 weeks** (vs Week 7 target)
5. **Cash position < $250K** (50% depletion)
6. **Runway < 16 weeks** (4-month warning)

## UNIT ECONOMICS & PROFITABILITY (Forward-Looking)

### Economics at Scale (After 12+ Customers)

```
TARGET UNIT ECONOMICS (18+ months out)

Customer Economics:
├─ Average ACV: $40K
├─ CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost): $3K-5K
├─ LTV (Lifetime Value, 3-year): $120K
├─ LTV:CAC Ratio: 24:1 (target: 3:1+) ✅
├─ CAC Payback Period: 2-4 months (target: <12 months) ✅
└─ Gross Margin: 70% (SaaS target) 🎯

Company Profitability (12+ customers):
├─ Monthly Revenue: $40K
├─ COGS (Cost of Goods Sold): $12K (30%)
├─ Gross Profit: $28K (70%)
├─ Operating Expenses: $25K (salaries + overhead)
├─ EBITDA: +$3K/month (breakeven approaching)
└─ Runway: Self-sustaining (no fundraising needed by Month 12+)
```

## FINANCIAL REPORTING & CADENCE

### Weekly Reports (Every Friday 5 PM)

**Who:** CFO / Project Manager
**What:**
- Cash position update
- Weekly spend vs. budget
- Cumulative burn vs. plan
- Revenue this week (if any)
- Forecast update (if revenue accelerated/delayed)

### Monthly Reports (1st Monday each month)

**Who:** CFO + Founder/CEO
**What:**
- Full P&L statement
- Cash flow statement
- Balance sheet snapshot
- Budget variance analysis (actual vs. plan)
- Burn rate trend
- Runway calculation
- KPI summary (MRR, ARR, CAC, LTV, etc.)

**Recipients:** Board, Investors, Key advisors

### Quarterly Reports (End of each quarter)

**Who:** CFO + Board
**What:**
- Full audited P&L, cash flow, balance sheet
- Quarterly performance vs. annual plan
- Updated financial projections
- Series A readiness metrics
- Unit economics analysis
- Headcount/salary review

## TAX & ACCOUNTING SETUP

### Tax Obligations (Delaware C-Corp)

```
FEDERAL TAXES
├─ Estimated Quarterly Taxes: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4
├─ Due dates: Apr 15, Jun 15, Sep 15, Jan 15 (next year)
├─ Estimated liability: $3K-5K (once revenue starts)
└─ Safe harbor: 90% of current year OR 100% of prior year

STATE TAXES
├─ Delaware franchise tax: $300-1000/year
├─ Sales tax (if applicable): Varies by state (TBD by state)
└─ Payroll taxes: 15.3% employer + employee contribution

ACCOUNTING
├─ System: QuickBooks Online or Wave (free)
├─ CPA support: Monthly or quarterly review
├─ Payroll: ADP or Rippling (if employees hired)
└─ Cost: $2K-5K/year for basic setup + quarterly review
```

### Bookkeeping Checklist

- [ ] Open business bank account (Jan 27)
- [ ] Setup accounting software (Jan 28)
- [ ] File corporate structure documents (Jan 27)
- [ ] Apply for EIN (Jan 27)
- [ ] Hire accountant/CPA (Jan 28)
- [ ] Setup payroll system (Feb 1)
- [ ] Collect I-9 forms for new hires (per hire)
- [ ] File quarterly payroll taxes (Apr 15)
- [ ] Reconcile books monthly (by 5th of month)
- [ ] Prepare annual tax return (by Mar 15, 2027)
